T: Looks like someone has a case of the Mondays. Have a snack.
D: A fed-up software engineer stops caring about his job and plots against the company with his mates.
P: Serve the cake when the office birthday cake goes round and skips Milton.
S: the flair-heavy restaurant across the road
Small potatoes baked, halved and scooped, brushed with butter and crisped at 220C, filled with cheddar and bacon, baked again, sour cream and chives.
Lavash cut into neat rectangles like sheets of paper, brushed with oil and salt, baked at 180C until crisp, stacked with a whipped feta dip in the middle.
Red capsicums roasted whole at 220C until blackened, peeled, cut into strips, dressed with olive oil, garlic, sherry vinegar and basil, on toasted bread.
M: Peter gutting a fish on his desk
Snapper fillets dusted in seasoned flour, pan-fried skin down in butter until crisp, with lemon, capers and parsley. Chips and a green salad.
the place where flair is mandatory
Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with barbecue sauce under a hot grill. Coleslaw.
W: Milton never gets a slice, you all do
Vanilla sheet cake baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in fluffy buttercream, cut into enough squares for everyone, Milton first.
K: Filter coffee made fresh in a big pot, milk and sugar on the side, mugs from the cupboard.

s.note: the flair-heavy restaurant across the road
s.how: Bake 8 small potatoes at 200C for 45 minutes. Halve, scoop and brush with 40g butter. Crisp at 220C for 10 minutes, fill with 150g cheddar and 150g cooked bacon and bake 5 more minutes. Top with sour cream and chives.

Cut 3 lavash breads into neat rectangles like sheets of paper. Brush with oil, salt and bake at 180C until crisp. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and stack the crackers around it. Did you get the memo?

m.note: Peter gutting a fish on his desk
m.how: Dust 4 snapper fillets in seasoned flour and fry skin down in butter until crisp, then flip. Add lemon juice, 1 tbsp capers and parsley to the pan. Fry 1kg potato chips twice. Serve with a green salad.

w.note: Milton never gets a slice, you all do
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake in a slab tin at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 200g butter with 350g icing sugar, spread on and cover with sprinkles. Cut a square for Milton first.

d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine. Pour into mugs from the cupboard with milk and sugar on the side. Yeah, if you could go ahead and refill it, that'd be great.
